Most damning is the valuation: intrinsic value (~$60.68B) is drastically lower than the market cap (~$1.3T), resulting in an unsustainable margin of safety of -95.32%. Additionally, there is no clear activism opportunity to unlock value, as margins are already decent or growth is weak. Given these factors, TSLA fails to meet the criteria of a high-quality business with a durable moat, consistent free cash flow, and attractive valuation. Therefore, a bearish stance is warranted with high confidence.
